name: Data.Pair.weylGauge_pointKernel_le_one
summary: Divisibility of jets of standard data (`mem_raises_of_dvd`): the point datum, scaled, lies in the standard data at l, and the jet scale and the boxes of the weight are cleared by denomBound(p).

steps.claim: The jets of the point datum are integral after multiplying by denomBound(p): the scaled datum lies in the standard data at l (`Parameters.smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData`, the level indicator being integral and l prime to Q), the scale conj(π_g) has |·| ≤ 1 (`norm_star_piG_le_one`), and the exponent of denomBound(p) covers the boxes of the weight (`mem_raises_of_dvd`); the gauge of the Weyl representation reduces to the coordinates (`schur_eq_one`).
steps.lean:
• pointKernel H ϑ g h) ≤ 1 := by simpa +contextual [weylGauge, weylRep, schur_eq_one] using!
  (mem_raises_of_dvd (pointDatum H ϑ) (hκ := isLiftWeight _) (ha := a_hasWeight _) (hb :=
  b_hasWeight _) (K := ⊤) (smul_vacuumDatum_mem_standardData norm_mul_gProd_pow_mem_modulus
  (by grind [AuxPair.levelIndicator, one_mem, zero_mem]) hl) norm_star_piG_le_one
  (by simp [denomBound, boxes, AuxPair.κ, mixedWeight, (lValueData H ϑ).one_lt_card, ← H.1]) _ _ 1)
